All values below are synthetic. They exist only to exercise the renderer: prose with a footnote[^note], a link to [the table](#table), a task list and display math, then every chart type and every rich block.

[^note]: Synthetic data; no figure here describes a real product.

- [x] Every rich fence tag appears at least once
- [ ] Nothing here is a real measurement

Term
: A definition list item, for the prose styles.

$$\bar{x} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i$$

### Code

def share(parts: dict[str, float]) -> dict[str, float]:
    total = sum(parts.values())
    return {name: value / total for name, value in parts.items()}
